companyContext: Family-owned Danish toy company founded in 1932 in Billund, designing and manufacturing the LEGO System in Play (interlocking plastic bricks, sets, video games and entertainment) sold in more than 120 countries with the mission to inspire and develop the builders of tomorrow through the power of play.
brandContext: Multi-year collaboration between the LEGO Group and The Pokémon Company International, launched 27 February 2026, that recreates iconic Pokémon (Pikachu, Eevee, Venusaur, Charizard, Blastoise, Mewtwo and more) in LEGO brick form across display sets for adults and interactive SMART Play sets for kids, inviting fans to continue their Pokémon Trainer journey one brick at a time.

brandVision: Bring together two beloved worlds — the endless possibilities of LEGO play and the 30-year adventure of Pokémon — to let fans of every age build, display and battle their favourite Pokémon brick by brick, expanding the Pokémon Trainer journey into the physical world through both adult collectible display sets and interactive SMART Play experiences for kids.
brandValues: Imagination, creativity and fun; learning through play; quality and safety; inclusivity for fans of all ages; nostalgia mixed with innovation (SMART Play tech); shared passion between two iconic family entertainment brands that push the boundaries of social and creative play.
